description: This file implements the CheckErrors class, which is a MethodOperation used within the OFBiz MiniLang framework to handle error checking logic in scripted methods. It processes error messages from the environment and sets appropriate response codes and error message lists.

classes.name: CheckErrors
classes.description: Represents the <check-errors> element operation in MiniLang, used for error handling during script execution within OFBiz.

classes.name: CheckErrorsFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CheckErrors from XML elements.

methods.name: CheckErrors
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CheckErrors object based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the error check operation, examining the environment's error message list and setting error codes accordingly.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the error code to set, defaulting to the method's default error code if none is specified.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <check-errors> element with its attributes.
